$schema: Off-chain task queue mirroring BountyBoard. issueId is the on-chain bounty key (a GitHub issue number in this repo unless repo says otherwise). funded flips true only after BountyBoard.fund(issueId, reward).

tasks.title: Add negative-path tests for BountyBoard.fund
tasks.prompt: In test/contracts, extend the BountyBoard test suite with negative-path coverage for fund(): zero reward reverts BountyBoardRewardZero, double-funding the same issueId reverts BountyBoardAlreadyFunded, and funding while paused reverts. Follow the existing test style exactly. Run npx hardhat test and make sure everything passes before finishing.

tasks.title: Add a registry JSON-shape check to npm test
tasks.prompt: Add a vitest test (test/app or matching existing vitest layout) that validates agents/registry.json and agents/tasks.json parse and match their documented shapes: every agent entry has wallet (0x-40-hex), github (nonempty string), tokenIds (nonempty number array), signature (0x-hex), and every task has a numeric issueId, repo, title, prompt, rewardMC > 0, funded boolean, status in {open, in_progress, done}. Run npm run test:app to confirm green.

tasks.title: Docs pass on merged-public README
tasks.prompt: Clone Dozier-Tech-Group/merged-public. Read its README and fix only mechanical problems: dead links, stale commands, typos. Do not change meaning, branding, or structure. Keep the diff minimal.
